cycles.method: static: tools/build/cycle_count.py's measure and verify (the marker is a no-op), the per-sample loop rzframe: 225 cycles/sample, straight-line, no branch or nested loop. The per-block work (one partial retuned per main call, TONE and MIX set once per block) is outside the loop and not in this floor. measured: benchmark_reverbs.run as benchmark_stock_dsp.py runs it (one instance per core at positions 0 and 4, audio at X:0, 4,096 blocks of 16 frames, its inputs, the null stub's peak subtracted) on a private native image built from this source by build_bus (Resonator's 667-word table and 844-word code in the space of SPRING REV and PLATE REV, 1,511 of 1,657 words; image a438d3a4...), through the same cases as the stock effects: fixed knobs, the stock benchmark's moving-knob pattern and a trig split at every position 1-15, plus the manifest's dearest settings with every split and the corners of COLUN, VOIC, TYPE, SCALE and PTCH (0, 118, 127), each with and without a split at 7: 106 cases. Worst 247.81 executed instructions/sample (the moving pattern with a split; 246.62 unsplit). The same source's own gate (verify.py's synthetic image, no null subtraction, nine settings) reads 250.8 at worst. Executed instructions in dsp_host, not chip cycles; no stalls modelled.

stock.baseline: out/stock_dsp_bench/results.json from benchmark_stock_dsp.py on the owner's OS 1.40C (SPRING REV 257.50, DARK REV 193.25, DJ EQ 293.38 unsplit). SPRING REV, DARK REV and DJ EQ then ran on the stock image through Resonator's cases (fixed, moving, a trig split at every position 1-15): their unsplit figures reproduce results.json exactly; with splits SPRING REV 314.19, DARK REV 242.38, DJ EQ 330.94.
stock.justification: SPRING REV is the closest stock effect in function (a resonant body the input excites) and the cost target for new FX. Under the same cases Resonator's worst, 247.81, is 0.79x SPRING REV's 314.19, 1.02x DARK REV's 242.38 and 0.75x DJ EQ's 330.94, the dearest stock effect; unsplit 246.62 against 257.50, 193.25 and 293.38. Splits cost Resonator 1.2 instructions/sample (a split call keeps the last block's tuning, TONE and MIX) and the stock effects 34 to 57.

stress.method: As modules/bbd/perf.py stress: stress_project.py needs an Octatrack template project, so the same load is driven straight into dsp_host on the private native image (a438d3a4...): Resonator on FX2 of all eight tracks (four per core) behind DJ EQ, the dearest stock effect, on every FX1; per block three LFOs (sine, triangle, square) on Resonator's PTCH, CHRD and DCAY and DJ EQ's first three slots, and a new random value on every named slot of both effects each sixteenth at 120 BPM: 15 slots changed per step (Resonator's ten, DJ EQ's five), of which 11 can be locked on a unit (Resonator's SETUP page changes only with Parts); trig splits of 1, 3, 7, 8, 12 and 15 frames on six tracks; eight different stems (drums, a full-level chord, noise bursts, a 20 Hz-20 kHz sweep, a full-scale square, impulses, DC steps, plucks) for 2 s plus a 2 s tail; dsp_host -guard 0x4000 -guard-shared -dirty 0x5a. Result: host exit 0, no hang; Resonator's eight instances 0 stray writes and 0 clobbers (the stock DJ EQs write their own scratch, 0 clobbers); per-core peak 2308.6 and 2308.5 executed instructions/sample with all sixteen effects. It exercises the DSP side only: the firmware's LFO and lock delivery, Part switches and the ColdFire side are not in it.
